2. Miscellaneous Application (IA No.2 of
2026) has been filed by the applicant with the
prayer to amend the memo of parties by
substituting the address of the respondents
with their correct address, namely, "Village
Lohali Aata Britta, District Nainital,
Uttarakhand".
3. Since there is mistake to the address of
the respondents and the applicant seeks to
rectify the address, hence Miscellaneous
Application (IA No.2 of 2026) is hereby allowed.
4. Let the amended cause title of the
Transfer Application be filed in the Registry
during the course of the day. Steps to be taken
within 5 days through all mode of service, if
permissible.
5. List on 13.08.2026.
